data.name: Everest
data.gender_notes: Everest is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘if’ and ‘stead’, Everest symbolizes unwavering stability and unchanging strength. This name is reminiscent of the majestic mountain, Everest, which stands tall and unyielding. The name Everest carries the meaning “Steadfast, enduring, unchanging” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Everest usually hope their child will grow to embody steadfast, enduring, unchanging and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes steadfastness in faith and unwavering commitment to one's beliefs.
data.etymology: Everest belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Steadfast, enduring, unchanging.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Everest total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Everest" is globally recognized due to the famous mountain of the same name, located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas. The mountain was named after Sir George Everest, a British Surveyor General of India from 1832 to 1843, who overseaw the initial charting of the region. Named in 1865, the mountain's elevation was later found to be the highest in the world. The name "Everest" has become synonymous with great heights, ambition, and challenge.
data.spiritual_significance: In many cultures, mountains are seen as sacred places and symbols of divine powers. For Christians, Everest carries a spiritual meaning as a spiritual testament to the unwavering strength and unyielding faith in God. The mountain's unchanging and towering presence reflects the eternal and unending nature of God, challenging and inspiring humanity to strive for greatness and reach for the heavens. The name Everest serves as a constant reminder of the Divine's unending love and support, providing strength and hope in times of need.
